journal.delete.title: Delete {weekday} {day} {month}?
journal.delete.lead: Everything kept on this day goes from this computer for good, with what Nocturne learned from it. Untick anything you want to keep.
journal.delete.group.otherNote: These share a memory with this day. The shared memory goes; these stay unless you tick them.
journal.delete.versions: Changed {time} · {count, plural, one {1 earlier version, goes with it} other {# earlier versions, go with it}}
journal.delete.versions.label: Earlier versions
journal.delete.cannotGo: Stays. Memories from other days still use it.
journal.delete.memories: And the {count, plural, one {memory} other {# memories}} Nocturne read from them.
journal.delete.memories.label: Memories that go with them
journal.delete.reflectionRecap: Your reflection on this day, and {count, plural, one {1 line in your recaps that cites it.} other {# lines in your recaps that cite it.}}
journal.delete.lines: {count, plural, one {1 line in your reflections and recaps cites these and will be taken out.} other {# lines in your reflections and recaps cite these and will be taken out.}}
journal.delete.nothing: Nothing is ticked, so nothing will be deleted.
journal.delete.done.memories: {count, plural, one {1 thing is} other {# things are}} gone from this computer, with the {memories, plural, one {memory} other {# memories}} read from them. They won’t appear in answers, pages or anywhere else.
journal.delete.done.plain: {count, plural, one {1 thing is} other {# things are}} gone from this computer. They won’t appear in answers, pages or anywhere else.
journal.delete.done.others: {count, plural, one {1 thing from another day stays.} other {# things from other days stay.}}
journal.deleteCheckin.title: Delete this check-in?
journal.deleteCheckin.body: {feel} at {time}, and the line you wrote with it, go from this computer for good.
journal.deleteCheckin.bodyBare: {feel} at {time} goes from this computer for good.
